articles.summary: Conference call and webcast to follow at 8:00 am PT / 11:00 am ET Avnet, Inc. (Nasdaq: AVT ), a leading global technology distributor and solutions provider, today announced it will report financial results for the first quarter fiscal year 2027 on November 4, 2026 before the market opens. Following the earnings release, Avnet’s Chief Executive Officer Phil Gallagher and Chief Financial Officer Ken Jacobson will host a webcast and conference call at 8:00 a.m. PT / 11:00 a.m. ET to discuss the financial results and provide a corporate update. Conference Call and Webcast Details To participate in the live call, dial 877-407-8112 or 201-689-8840. The live webcast along with slides can be accessed via Avnet’s Investor Relations web page at www.ir.avnet.com or by accessing the webcast directly at https://avt-q1-2027.open-exchange.net/ . articles.summary: Boss Battle in the AI Arena challenge invites developers to build innovative AI-powered applications using PSOC Edge technologies PHOENIX Hackster, an Avnet community, has launched the Boss Battle in the AI Arena challenge in collaboration with Infineon, inviting developers worldwide to create innovative Edge AI projects using PSOC Edge technologies. The competition builds on the successful PSOC Edge City learning program, where participants developed practical skills in designing and deploying AI-powered applications. In the challenge, participants will compete against the Infineon engineering team by developing projects that demonstrate creativity, technical expertise and real-world problem-solving using the PSOC Edge E84 AI Kit and DEEPCRAFT Studio. articles.summary: Global engineering community invites makers and engineers to create Halloween-themed electronics projects for the chance to win prizes element14 Community, an Avnet community, has launched its 2026 Halloween Hackathon, inviting engineers, makers and electronics enthusiasts worldwide to build and share Halloween-themed electronics projects for the chance to win prizes. Participants are encouraged to create projects ranging from electronic decorations and interactive costumes to automated trick-or-treater spooking devices and other Halloween-inspired builds. To enter, members must submit a project write-up explaining how their creation works and how it was built. "The Halloween Hackathon is always one of the most creative events on our calendar," said Andreea Teodorescu, Global Director of Product Marketing and element14 Community.
